title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Particular Requirements for Stationary Cooking Ranges, Hobs, Ovens and Similar Appliances

clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: IS 302-2-6 (based on IEC 60335-2-6) specifies safety requirements for stationary electric cooking ranges, hobs, ovens, and similar appliances for household use, rated voltage up to 250V single-phase or 480V 3-phase. This standard is mandatory for ISI certification of cooking appliances sold in India.
